says: The radial wheel's lit slice (Ordaen/wheel.luna, CONE): a wedge with its point at the bottom's middle and its edges to the top corners, gold, faint at the point and brightest towards the rim with a soft outer edge. The wheel's box stretches it to the chosen slice's width and turns it towards the item.
origin: Drawn by wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/wheel-cone.mjs` (a page of one clipped radial gradient), shot at 2x on black and on white with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 128 --height 128 --scale 2` (`?bg=black`, `bg=white`), then matted.
